description: Search clinical terms/codes → UMLS concepts (CUIs). Maps free text or a source code to UMLS concept unique identifiers spanning SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC, MeSH, etc. Example: umls_search({ query: "myocardial infarction", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Free UMLS UTS API key (from your UTS profile at uts.nlm.nih.gov)

query.description: A clinical term, phrase, or source code to search, e.g. "heart attack" or "410.0"

return_type.description: Optional identifier type to return: "concept" (default, CUIs), "code" (source codes), or "sourceConcept".

source.description: Optional source vocabulary abbreviation (SAB) to restrict results, e.g. "SNOMEDCT_US", "ICD10CM", "RXNORM", "LNC", "MSH". Comma-separate for multiple.

name: umls_search
title: Umls Search
